description: 12h memory-stability soak - Node.js valkey-glide-node, one cell. There is no bench-aws.sh version flag for this client: bump @valkey/valkey-glide in node/package.json and node/package-lock.json on a pushed ref and pass --repo-tag. Memory signal: engine process-group RSS sampled every 5s into <label>.system.ndjson. 64 connections = 64 async workers on the engine's single event loop; below the ~100-connection plateau in docs/BENCHMARKS_NODE.md, so the loop is not the bottleneck on an 8-vCPU m5.2xlarge. Launch with --runtime-cap 780 so the cap never fires before the upload; run soakctl-node on its own instance in parallel as the control.
